primary_estimand.name: total_multivariate_rate_ratio
primary_estimand.japanese_rate: dated phylogenetic evolutionary rate for each core axis in dominant Japanese radiation
primary_estimand.background_rate: corresponding non-Japanese Cirsium rate on the same dated global tree
primary_estimand.scale_rule: standardize each axis using non-Japanese background distribution before rate estimation

admission_sequence: trait recovery frozen before rate outcomes
outcome-blind precision simulation under current coverage
primary R_total analysis only if identifiable
secondary_eazami_discrete_layer: trait-specific CTMC rate estimates where identifiable
prohibited_shortcuts: claim acceleration from six >=10-observation Japanese taxa alone
assign broad binomial images to named infraspecific concepts
select fastest single trait after outcome inspection
equate image armature proxies with botanical phyllary/spine states
treat discrete Japanese trait rates as globally exceptional without a homologous comparator
claim_boundary: Gate 0B tests whether phenotypic accumulation is accelerated. It does not identify the genomic mechanism or adaptive value.
